name: 帧间伪造检测
description: 检测视频序列中的帧插入、删除和复制攻击。
useCase: Identifying temporal manipulation through inter-frame relationship analysis
mechanism: Analyzes inter-frame correlation patterns, motion vectors, and prediction residuals to detect frame-level tampering. Frame insertion/deletion disrupts the natural correlation sequence, while frame duplication creates detectable repetition patterns in the motion field.
source: Wu, Y. et al. (2014) - Exposing Video Inter-Frame Forgery by Zernike Opponent Chromaticity Moments. Multimedia Systems
algorithm: Inter-Frame Correlation + Motion Vector Analysis + Prediction Residual Anomaly Detection
parameters: Correlation: Pearson/SSIM, Motion vectors: block matching, Residual threshold: adaptive, Window: entire video
